title: Migration Execution Plan — Framework v1 → Framework v2
purpose: Defines the staged migration from Framework v1 to Framework v2 with specific session assignments, authorization gates, rollback criteria, success metrics, and the hybrid/shadow mode operational plan.

stage_1_hybrid_mode.label: Hybrid Mode — Framework v1 + v2 Coexist
stage_1_hybrid_mode.description: Framework v2 engines are built alongside v1. Both operate simultaneously. v2 produces artifacts that v1 boards consume. No v1 tool is turned off.
stage_1_hybrid_mode.v1_status: Fully operational. QID-only tools continue functioning via backward-compat shim.
stage_1_hybrid_mode.v2_status: Engines implemented, tested, producing artifacts. Artifacts consumed by v2 boards in parallel with v1 boards. v2 boards operate in advisory mode — recommendations not blocking.
exit_criteria: All 5 identity engines operational with test suite passing
CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json contains all 2,500 items with stable identity_keys
Scan Engine produces stable results across 2 consecutive runs
Governance guard Rules 6-10 deployed and passing
Pre-flight pipeline operational: Gates -1 through 4 produce classifications

stage_2_shadow_mode.label: Shadow Mode — v2 Runs Authoritatively, v1 in Parallel
stage_2_shadow_mode.description: Framework v2 runs as the primary certification pipeline. v1 boards continue in parallel for validation. All certifications must go through v2. v1 serves as the verification baseline — any divergence between v1 and v2 decisions triggers investigation.
stage_2_shadow_mode.v1_status: Operational in verification mode only. v1 boards retain read access but lose write authority. Certification decisions flow through v2 exclusively.
stage_2_shadow_mode.v2_status: Authoritative certification pipeline. All boards (Registry, Quality, Governance, Certification) operational. Delta review skips 80% of items.
exit_criteria: v2 certification decisions consistent with v1 on ≥95% of items
Readiness failure rate < 44.7% (50% improvement from v1 baseline)

stage_3_framework_v2.label: Framework v2 — Full Operation
stage_3_framework_v2.description: Framework v2 is the sole certification pipeline. v1 tools fully retired. All operations through compound-key identity. All 4 reports per session.
key_deliverables: Certification Board refocus from re-verification to governance-sufficiency (S219-S220)
S311 EW Factory standard mandatory for new content
stage_3_framework_v2.v1_status: Fully retired. v1 boards, reports, and QID-only tools decommissioned. Legacy artifacts archived.
stage_3_framework_v2.v2_status: Sole operational pipeline. 5 boards. 4 reports/session. ≤7 agents/session. 3.8× throughput.
exit_criteria: All BF metrics at v2 targets

stage_4_legacy_retirement.label: Legacy Retirement — v1 Artifacts Archived
stage_4_legacy_retirement.description: All v1 artifacts (reports, board outputs, QID-only tools) moved to reports/legacy/. No v1 code path remains in the active repository.
key_deliverables: QID-only backward-compat shim removed from Navigation Registry
Governance guard Rules 9-10 are the sole enforcement path

S830_phase_2_activation.checkpoint: End of Hybrid Mode → authorization to enter Shadow Mode
S830_phase_2_activation.authorization: Session arbiter + Governance Board joint sign-off. All HARD_BLOCK conditions must PASS.

S900_phase_3_activation.checkpoint: End of Shadow Mode → authorization to enter Framework v2
S900_phase_3_activation.authorization: Session arbiter + Governance Board. All HARD_BLOCK conditions must PASS.

rollback_criteria.description: Conditions that trigger immediate rollback to the previous migration stage.
triggers: v2 certification decisions diverge from v1 on >10% of items (Shadow Mode)
Identity key instability: >5 items produce different identity_keys across 2 consecutive AM-1 extractions
Registry integrity failure: entry count ≠ grep count at any checkpoint
Pre-flight pipeline produces unstable readiness classifications across 2 consecutive runs
New defect class discovered that v1 would have caught but v2 did not (defect escape rate >5%)
Governance guard Rule 9 or Rule 10 produces HARD_BLOCK that cannot be resolved within 1 session
rollback_procedure: 1. Halt all v2 engines and boards
2. Revert to v1 certification pipeline for all active items
4. Fix v2 engine + add regression test
5. Re-enter Hybrid Mode after fix validation
6. Re-run migration verification on all 2,500 items

metrics.target: Identical defect counts across 2 consecutive scan runs
Entry count = grep count at all checkpoints
0 Certified items with DL-008 after Gate 1 deployment
0 false-positive content_hash changes (hash stable across sessions)

shadow_mode_operational_plan.description: During Shadow Mode (S208-S215), both v1 and v2 operate simultaneously. v2 is authoritative for certification; v1 serves as verification baseline.

daily_operations.t0: Both pipelines initiate simultaneously. v2 pre-flight runs (~51s). v1 boards initialize.
daily_operations.t_mid: v2 certification decisions flow to v1 boards for validation. v1 boards compare v2 decisions against their own assessments. Discrepancies logged as SHADOW_DISCREPANCY events.
daily_operations.t_end: Governance Board reconciles v1-v2 discrepancies. Resolution documented. If discrepancies > 5% → escalate to governance.

discrepancy_handling.v1_certifies_v2_holds: Investigate: v2 gate caught a defect v1 missed? Or v2 false positive? Resolution documented.
discrepancy_handling.v2_certifies_v1_holds: Investigate: v2 delta review inherited incorrectly? Or v1 was overly conservative? Resolution documented.
discrepancy_handling.v1_v2_agree: Default case (target ≥95%). No investigation needed. Certification decision accepted.

exit_checklist: v1-v2 agreement ≥95% for 3 consecutive certification waves
Zero identity-related discrepancies across 3 consecutive waves
Zero Delta Review false-positive inheritance across 3 consecutive waves
BF-004, BF-005, BF-007 all at v2 threshold or better
Governance Board sign-off for Shadow Mode exit
